description: This file provides function declarations for HMAC (Hash-based Message Authentication Code) computations using various hash functions (MD5, SHA1, SHA256, SHA512). It acts as a wrapper for these HMAC algorithms in the lighttpd project.

methods.name: li_hmac_md5
methods.description: Computes HMAC using MD5 hash function.

methods.name: li_hmac_sha1
methods.description: Computes HMAC using SHA1 hash function.

methods.name: li_hmac_sha256
methods.description: Computes HMAC using SHA256 hash function.

methods.name: li_hmac_sha512
methods.description: Computes HMAC using SHA512 hash function.
